messages.text: Where is my order? Order # Shop····.

Hi Jonathan, your B30 and the Power Kit are both still to ship on Shop····. Batch 1 left the factory on October 15 and the US units are landing at our Chattanooga warehouse now. The P. Kit is already reserved there; yours ships as soon as the B30 is checked in, and the tracking goes straight to your email.

You can follow that shipment on its way to us here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

Anything else you want me to check while you're here?
I have a dead miner from prior purchase

Sorry to hear it. From us you've got a NerdQaxe++ Rev 6.1, a Nexus S1 and L1, a Hammer DC02 and a Bitaxe Gamma. Which one died, and what does it do when you power it up, nothing at all, fans but no hashing, or an error on screen?
*(Handed to our technical specialist, who picks this up next.)*
Listen I have other miners that the PS works on. The miner is dead

Back with you on the order side, Jonathan. Understood, the unit is dead and the supply is proven.

That's enough for us: Hal confirmed it as a hardware fault, and the return on your NerdQaxe++ (order Shop····, May 25) is with JD and Georges for approval now. Nothing more for you to test.

Once it's approved we'll confirm by email with the return details, and I'll post it here too. Please keep the unit and its power supply boxed up in the meantime.
